title: Basement garage thugs
summary: Ragged brawlers, knifers and gunmen now prowl the B1–B5 basement garage, deadliest at the bottom.
notes: Put every garage enemy on the player model: ragged brawlers punch, hooded knifers sprint in with a blade and masked gunmen shoot.
Add 17 enemies to the basement garage below the casino, with gunmen only on B4 and B5.
Make gunmen the toughest enemies and knifers the fastest.
